description: Run 'skoll rfc' from ~/PROJECT/PKIX. This is the highest-signal scan for this project — it checks MUST/SHOULD/MAY conformance against specifications. PKIX implements RFC 5280 path validation, RFC 6125 hostname binding, RFC 8398 S/MIME mailbox binding, RFC 3161 timestamping, RFC 6960 OCSP, and RFC 6962 CT. The scan should surface any spec-text deviations. Save output: 'skoll rfc --out ~/PROJECT/PKIX/reports/skoll-rfc.md'. Also run scoped variants: 'skoll rfc --full pkix-path/src/' and 'skoll rfc --full pkix-chain/src/' for deeper coverage of the core crates.
